title: Pawns
info: A pawn moves forward one square, or two squares on its first move. It never moves backward.
A pawn captures diagonally forward, not straight ahead. If it reaches the far rank, it becomes another piece, often a queen.

questions.q: On its first move a pawn may go
Reaching the far rank lets a pawn
options: become another piece, often a queen
leave the board and return as a king

questions.q: An enemy piece directly in front of a pawn
options: turns the pawn into a rook at once
